description: This file defines the sparc-specific stack walker class 'StackwalkerSPARC' for use in crash dump analysis, including its constructor, private methods, and context storage.

classes.name: StackwalkerSPARC
classes.description: A class that implements sparc-specific stack walking functionality, inheriting from Stackwalker.

methods.name: StackwalkerSPARC
methods.description: Constructor initializing the sparc-specific stack walker with system info, context, memory, modules, and symbolizer.

methods.name: GetContextFrame
methods.description: Returns the current context stack frame based on sparc register context.

methods.name: GetCallerFrame
methods.description: Returns the caller's stack frame, possibly performing stack scan.
